content: Defense-in-depth auth in Next.js 16: proxy.ts = fast edge gate for redirects (may even be skipped/bypassed — CVE-2025-29927, matcher gaps, static exports); Server Components = page-level authz scoped by user; data access layer = every query scoped by userId as a security control; route handlers/server actions = own 401/403 per operation. Client hooks (useUser/useAuth/role-gated nav) shape UI only — never the security boundary. Role checks must be per-mutation, per-resource on the server.
